_help: Pool of one-line idea / direction / technique candidates. The user rates Y/N on /ideas.html; ratings.json captures the verdict. Mutation worker can bias toward Y-rated ideas in directive sampling. Each idea may link to related project codes (pieces) — usually the parent piece or a sibling demonstrating the idea. id is stable; do not renumber.
